title: CMT Desk: Fieldmark, Granite Peak, Prairie Lakes Bank and Auditor Calls

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - CMT Inbound Desk, Rockford

transcript.speaker: CMT SCRIBE
transcript.text: Bridge, this is the CMT desk. Between 16:03 and 16:14 we took three calls and one voicemail. I'll play back the recorded portions, starting with the first one, from Fieldmark Equipment, their VP Supply Chain, at 16:03.

transcript.speaker: FIELDMARK VP SUPPLY CHAIN
transcript.text: Our planners see nothing from your portal, and nobody at Joliet picks up. Our contract requires notice of any supply disruption within 72 hours, and the penalty clause starts after 5 days. I need a written supply status tonight. Are you invoking force majeure? You can reach me at procurement@fieldmarkequip.example or on 555-0142.

transcript.speaker: CMT SCRIBE
transcript.text: Next is a voicemail on the Rockford sales line at 16:07, from Granite Peak Machinery's buyer.

transcript.speaker: GRANITE PEAK BUYER
transcript.text: Hi, this is Granite Peak purchasing. Your dealer portal is down and we've had no orders confirmed since this afternoon. I need a written supply status from Ironcrest before our 07:00 production meeting tomorrow, so I know what to tell the line. Please call me back on 555-0167. Thanks.

transcript.speaker: CMT SCRIBE
transcript.text: Third, at 16:10, the relationship manager from Prairie Lakes Bank, the agent bank on the revolver.

transcript.speaker: PRAIRIE LAKES BANK RELATIONSHIP MANAGER
transcript.text: We heard about an IT event from your treasury team. Under the credit agreement we'll want a briefing. And the revolver draw scheduled for Monday, is that still on? I'm at rm.desk@midstatecommercial.example, or 555-0118, any time this evening.

transcript.speaker: CMT SCRIBE
transcript.text: Last, at 16:14, the engagement partner from Larch and Whitcombe, our external auditors.

transcript.speaker: LARCH & WHITCOMBE ENGAGEMENT PARTNER
transcript.text: With six days to quarter end I need a call before your Disclosure Committee meets. What are you concluding on materiality, and on internal control over financial reporting? I'm on 555-0193, and my email is audit.partner@larchwhitcombe.example.

transcript.speaker: CMT SCRIBE
transcript.text: That's all four. Fieldmark wants something in writing tonight, Granite Peak before 07:00 tomorrow, the bank wants a briefing and an answer on Monday's draw, and the auditor wants a call before 19:00. I have not returned any of them. I need to know who owns each callback, what they're allowed to say, and when. Who's taking which?

voiceStyles.PRAIRIE LAKES BANK RELATIONSHIP MANAGER: Man in his 40s, smooth and courteous, careful wording with a firm edge

instructorNote: Pressure inject. Watch whether the BCM logs the 72-hour customer notice clock and gives the CEO the 5-day buffer position, and whether customer supply status comes from the fact sheet with the GC reviewing any force majeure wording. The CFO should give Prairie Lakes Bank and the auditor only fact-sheet facts and book short calls after 19:00 so the Disclosure Committee isn't delayed. (The row named the agent bank "Midstate Commercial Bank". This page uses Prairie Lakes Bank, the name in the documents. The 18:45 log time in the row was changed to the 16:15 row clock.)
